notes.title: [Update] Notice Regarding Screen Aspect Ratio Issues and Stuttering
notes.notes: [p]We have received reports from some players experiencing abnormal screen aspect ratios (stretched or compressed images) and even stuttering during gameplay. Our investigation shows that this issue is often related to [b]GPU performance limitations[/b] or [b]image upscaling technologies (such as DLSS)[/b]. When GPU load is too high, the game may automatically adjust its rendering method to maintain smooth performance, which can lead to aspect ratio issues in certain display modes.[/p][p][b]Recommended solutions:[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Try [b]disabling DLSS[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Lower graphics quality settings (effects, textures, etc.).[/p][/*][*][p]Reduce game resolution.[/p][/*][*][p]Lower FPS limit.[/p][/*][*][p]Update your graphics card drivers to the latest version (both NVIDIA and AMD supported).[/p][/*][/olist]
